title: 第一卷第11章 认怂这种事只有零次和无数次第一卷第12章 反杀
content_zh:
顾寒将阿傻的情况跟黑影详细说了一遍。
“咦？”
黑影有了点兴趣。
“你这名小侍女，身份可是不简单啊！”
“为什么这么说？”
“魂魄乃是修行之人的根本，若有损伤，除非修至本君这样神魂不灭的境界，否则凭她凡人之身，必然活不过三年！可你这名小侍女并无丝毫修为，却安安稳稳活了这么多年，定然是有人以逆天手段将她魂魄封印，阻止了魂力流失，有这种实力的人，修为就算比不上本君，也差不了多少了！”
顾寒眉头紧锁。
他自然询问过阿傻的身世。
可阿傻连最近两年的记忆都有些不清楚，又如何会记得这些事情？
她简单的脑瓜里。
只有顾寒，鸡腿，以及半个顾天。
“既然有了封印，那为何……”
“这还用问？定然是封印破了，你不是说他这两天总嚷嚷困？那就是魂力流失的表现了！”
“那该怎么办？”
“很简单！”
黑影突然卖起了关子。
“但是有个条件！”
“说！”
“你放了本君！”
顾寒沉默了一瞬。

噗！
下一刻。
一道凛然的剑意瞬间将黑影洞穿！
“小王八蛋！”
他气急败坏。
“你承诺过的，不再对本君动手！”
“我反悔了！”
“你……”
“说不说？”
“……她这种情况，要么拿养魂的灵丹圣药续命，要么就等本君恢复修为，将她的魂魄重新封印，除此之外，别无他法！”
他看得出来。
若是再继续要挟，顾寒真的会撕破脸，将他彻底斩灭。
认怂这种事。
只有零次和无数次。
所以，这一次他选择了秒怂。
“没别的办法了？”
顾寒有点不死心。
“你不是自称魔君吗，张口一个蝼蚁，闭口一个蝼蚁，就这么点能耐？”
content_en:
Gu Han explained Asha's situation to Heiying in detail.
"Huh?"
Black Shadow became a little interested.
"Your little maid's identity is not simple!"
"Why do you say that?"
"The soul is the foundation of a cultivator. If it is damaged, unless she has cultivated to a state where the soul is immortal like me, she will definitely not live for three years in a mortal body! But this little maid like you has no cultivation at all, but she has lived peacefully for so many years. Someone must have sealed her soul with heaven-defying means to prevent the loss of soul power. The cultivation level of a person with this kind of strength is not much worse than that of me, even if it is not as good as me!"
Gu Han frowned.
Naturally, he asked about Ah Sha's life experience.
But Ah Sha’s memory of the past two years is somewhat unclear, so how could he remember these things?
In her simple mind.
There was only Gu Han, chicken legs, and half of Gu Tian.
"Since there is a seal, why..."
"Do you even need to ask? The seal must have been broken. Didn't you say that he has been complaining about sleepiness these past two days? That's a sign of the loss of soul power!"
"What should we do?"
"It's easy!"
The black shadow suddenly became suspicious.
"But there's a condition!"
"Say!"
"You let me go!"
Gu Han was silent for a moment.
puff!
The next moment.
An awe-inspiring sword intent instantly penetrated the black shadow!
"Little bastard!"
He was furious.
"You promised not to do anything to me again!"
"I regretted it!"
"You..."
"Say or not?"
"...In her case, she can either take the soul-nurturing elixir to prolong her life, or wait for me to recover and seal her soul again. Other than that, there is no other way!"
He could tell.
If he continues to threaten him, Gu Han will really tear him apart and kill him completely.
There is such a thing as giving up.
There are only zero and countless times.
Therefore, this time he chose to give up immediately.
"Is there no other way?"
Gu Han was a little unwilling to give up.
"Don't you call yourself the Demon King? You're like an ant when you open your mouth, like an ant when you shut up. That's all you have."
